r.t: Kaji and Marco went to the store where the woman was a regular,the woman said to say that they were introduced by Tsukitate . They appeared at the door of the casino and said over the intercom system that they were introduced by Tsukitate,a person over the intercoms was originally not going to let them in but upon seeing the money he allowed them in. The person opened the door and allowed them in,the person said that there weren't any other customers today,and what game  kaji  wanted to play. Marco pointed at the person and said that he was bit by a rat. The person behind the main person asked if he was insulting his aniki. The main person said stop Magoroku but internally was happy,Marco quickly defeated Magoroku.

Aniki kicked Magoroku and apologised for his rudeness ,Kaji was about to leave when Magoroku said that they will discover who he is when he goes to another casino and find him when he is alone. Kaji agreed to play with him,Magoroku asked which type of a game he wanted to play,Kaji said a skill based game,Magoroku said that seven card stud was the perfect game for him (see sources section for an explanation of what it is). Kaji checked the cards and alongside Aniki decided to set the ante to 100 thousand. Kanji’s face up cards were a 1 pair of queens and were higher than Aniki’ and in total Kaji had 2 pairs.Kaji betted 500 thousand yen,Aniki decided to fold and raise the limit,he raised 1 million.Kaji decided to call and Aniki’s cards were higher and he won. They played many rounds and in the end Kaji lost the 30 million.

Kaji decided to summon the referees of Kakerou,referee number 1 Nowa Mitoshi arrived,Kaji said that he wanted Nowa to preside over the march ,he was ready to face any consequence if he lost and he wanted to regain the money he lost,Aniki said that he will only consider it if he bets his membership. Nowa said that’s impossible,though if the member agrees it will be done,his value doesn’t match the value of a membership. Nowa explained his mind is brilliant and he can estimate a person's value and not what they will make ,Aniki’s value is 1 million yen and Kaji’s is 100 yen.

Aniki asked how he could appraise the value of a human with money and they were humans. Nowa said that was his kindness,those prices are just guidelines for referees when they are in charge of intermediation,betting what one has is essential to a gamble and one should gamble along ones rank,though debt collecting is also his job,if you bet something you don’t have he will be the guarantor,and if one is unable to pay a wager every means will be used to extract as much as possible,the maximum is 2 million . Kaji was worried and noticed a Kariume candy which Baku often ate,upon eating the candy he calmed down (see sources section). Kaji asked if he could play another game with him and he couldn’t go home like this.Kaji asked to use another deck over there since he thought this one was unlucky for him. Aniki said he will reconsider if Magoroku punches his friend over there,making them even. Kaji was about to refuse but Marco accepted. Marco didn’t receive an injury but the hand of Magoroku was destroyed.

Nowa gave Kaji 2 million yen,Nowa asked why he didn’t gamble his life,Kaji said the membership belonged to someone else and in this private gamble he would only bet things belonging to him. A referee was distributing the cards using a specific dealing shoe,Kaji said that see one can cheat using that method,Nowa said that a pro can draw any card he wants in any shoe,Kaji agreed and said the cards will be arranged in a grid and drawn in order,A referee asked whether he wants a cheating rule to be added,Kaji said that he doesn’t trust them and he will monitor the cards himself,Aniki said it is fine with him. The match began and the cards were distributed, Aniki thought he won since Kaji only has 2.2 million and he will run out before the last round (see clarification section). Kaji called 100 thousand,Aniki betted 1.6 million. Kaji explained it was a coincidence and because he was unaware of it he misled Aniki into believing in it,assumptions are dangerous in gambling. Kaji took more money out of the bag and called 1.6 million. Kaji won the round. Kaji marvelled at the feeling of not being controlled by money but rather controlling it. Kaji was about to leave but Aniki offered to play another round in which if he loses he will lose 6 times the bet. Kaji agreed. Aniki thought that these cards were deuce cards and he would win . Kaji raised 200 thousand,for the next turn Kaji added more money . Kaji then called. Aniki thought he won with a full house.

Aniki reasoned that he replaced the card,he stole the card when he asked the deck to be replaced. Aniki was about to say he saw him cheat,but he was interrupted by Kaji who said he made an insurance claim.Aniki realised his actual card was covered by a piece of a spade card. Aniki realised he was playing,Kaji said Aniki will bet 3.2 million and then Kaji will raise,then and only then Aniki will fold. Kaji was then raised by 100 yen. Aniki followed suit. Kaji won 38.4 million, Aniki was going to be turned into money since he was 5 million short. A referee named Chris Lee knocked him out ,Magoroku tried to stop him,before Chris Lee was able to knock Magoroku out Marco interfered.

Marco was defeated,Nowa told Kaji that Usogui allowed a previous ally of his to die,Nowa will command the other to anesthetise him and carry him away,upon being injected with a needle he turned into Rodem and defeated them. Now a terrified man summoned the Kakerou Soldiers guarding the entrance. Nowa decided to use gunmen to kill Rodem . Suddenly Baku appeared behind him and said that it won’t happen. Baku said don’t look up and the one with greater power is the one who makes the decisions,he entered the premises and disarmed the soldiers during the chaos and is now the only person who can prevent the tragedy. Baku said you will now become my pawn. Baku said he wouldn’t call for support since it would be unsightly for one of the oldest referees and unlike other referees he isn’t too stubborn  . Baku said he should make a decision before anyone dies. Nowa said he used those 2 as bait didn’t he,Baku said he expected Kaji to call a referee but Nowa’s personality caused this,Nowa admitted he might’ve gone too far. Baku said he simply wants him to set up a match. Nowa said he will fulfill Baku’s request,Baku said he is thinking something bad. Nowa said not as bad as you’re thinking,Baku said that’s hurtful.
